This seemingly simple act of kindness stays with Yumi the rest of the day, and she speaks of her meeting with Sachiko to her friends during class and lunch. After school is over, Yumi's classmate Tsutako Takeshima meets with Yumi to show her that she took a photograph of Yumi's meeting with Sachiko earlier that morning. Yumi asks if she can have the photo, but Tsu

title: Onna Doushi to ka Arienai deshou to Iiharu Onnanoko wo, Hyakunichi-kan de Tetteiteki ni Otosu Yuri no Ohanashi
title_original: 女同士とかありえないでしょと言い張る女の子を、百日間で徹底的に落とす百合のお話
description: “Girls dating each other? That can’t be!….That's how it should be! A popular high-school girl, Sakakibara Marika, one day she get one million offer from her beautiful classmate, Fuwa Aya. “Sakakibara-san, For 100 days I will give you 10,000 yen/day. I will buy you. Let me show you that it’s possible for two girls dating each other” “Ha..Haaa?!” From that day, it started, their after school xx time. (Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival
title_original: 乙女ゲームのヒロインで最強サバイバル
title_en: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
description: Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she’s determined to carve her own path. (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Kämpfer
description: Kämpfer - One who exists to fight. Anyone chosen as a Kämpfer will be forced to fight until death. Our hero, Natsuru-san, awoke to find himself chosen as a Kämpfer. Only one thing for him changed. He is now a She!!! (Source: MangaTrader)

title: Aku no Musume
description: A vast kingdom called Lucifenia, whose popular name was the "Kingdom of Yellow," was ruled by a tyrannical fourteen year-old princess named Riliane. Under her absolute monarchism, everything was exploited from people and the ones who did not obey her were executed without mercy. Allen, a servant who looked a lot like her, was always beside the princess whom Lucifenia's people called the "Daughter of Evil." The princess and the servant were the same age, since the two of them were actually twins who were separated shortly after their birth, with Riliane taking her mother's position as the country's ruler and Allen works in the palace as a servant since he was given up for adoption. The princess's selfishness and jealousy caused a war and many deaths, and their secret clockwork of fate was going to spin madly. (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

title: Seiyuu Radio no Uraomote
title_original: 声優ラジオのウラオモテ
description: Yuuhi Yuugure and Yasumi Utatane, two high school voice actresses who just happened to attend the same school and coincidentally got placed into the same class, are the two hosts of a radio weekly program. As fellow classmates and voice actresses, they show all the listeners their great friendship! At least, on the surface. In reality, the quiet girl Chika and the gyaru Yumiko are complete opposites. And they absolutely cannot stand each other. Off air, chaos and insults erupt. On air, they're the best of friends. Just where will this tumultuous relationship lead them?

title: Isekai ni Saku wa Yuri no Hana
title_original: 異世界に咲くは百合の花
title_en: A Lily Blooms in Another World
description: Miyako Florence isn’t sad when her fiancée breaks off their engagement after two years. It’s all according to plan! Whisked to the world of her favorite otome game, Miyako frees herself from a dull noble to pursue her true soulmate: the game’s villainess Fuuka Hamilton. Proud Fuuka only has eyes for their mutual ex-fiancée! Miyako confesses her love to Fuuka and proposes that they run away together. Fuuka agrees on one condition: Miyako must make her say “I’m happy” in 14 days. With conniving nobles, strange diseases, and magical rituals pulling them apart, can Miyako win the villainess’s heart? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Yoku Wakaranai keredo Isekai ni Tensei Shiteita You desu
title_original: よくわからないけれど異世界に転生していたようです
description: I am cute, but I was a middle-aged researcher in my previous life?! Surviving in another world with magic and sciences!! The orphan Ren was riding the carriage after being sold, when she got involved into an accident, and got her previous life's memories back! "I was... a middle-aged man!" Indeed, she was a researcher in his thirties in her previous life, and had been living as an orphan girl up to now! Ren will make use of her talents in magic and knowledge in science to survive in this harsh world in order to escape from the investor who bought her!

title: Watashi no Yuri mo, Eigyou da to Omotta?
title_original: わたしの百合も、営業だと思った？
title_en: Did You Think My Yuri Was Just for Show?
description: Suzune Senmiya, a young voice actress, has been struggling for six months to get over the retirement of her favorite idol, Karin Kanezuki. One day, Karin shows up as a new voice actress in Suzune's agency! While Suzune tries to play it cool and keep her distance, Karin aggressively closes the gap between them. And as Suzune starts to see unexpected sides of Karin, she begins to perceive her not just as an idol but as a woman. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Hitozuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshikousei ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
title_original: 人妻教師が教え子の女子高生にドはまりする話
description: Itsuki Ichigohara is a married high-school teacher in her late 20's, who finds herself involved with a high school girl, her student, who is 10 years younger. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She is taller than Itsuki, with a beautiful face, mild-mannered but a little childish sometimes. Rin is a good girl, but she has problems in her family life, and as Itsuki tries to counsel her, they somehow end up kissing in bed together. This is an adulterous betrayal, not to mention a crime. How could she have got herself into such trouble that could only lead to her own destruction? — How could I have let this happen? It is a lewd and immoral, but somehow heartwarming relationship. A love story between a female teacher and her female student. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: VTuber nanda ga Haishin Kiri Wasuretara Densetsu ni Natteta
title_original: VTuberなんだが配信切り忘れたら伝説になってた
title_en: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral After Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream
description: Twenty-year-old former wage slave Yuki Tanaka now works among her idols: the streamers of Live-On, one of Japan’s top VTuber companies. As the gorgeous, polite Awayuki Kokorone, she delivers only the most ladylike content. Unfortunately, her subscriber count and savings are at rock bottom. One evening, after Yuki thinks she’s ended her stream, she cracks a few cold ones—and more than a few crude jokes—while watching Live-On’s video archives. But her viewers hear it all, and clips of her bawdy, drunken commentary go viral overnight. Yuki thinks her career is over...until her manager reveals that everyone at Live-On has been waiting for her to snap all along and gives her free rein to drink on-stream. Now free of all feigned purity, she jumps right into her new “rowdy drunk” character and is welcomed into the fold by her fellow Live-On VTubers, who turn out to be just as crazy as she is! With her views and finances skyrocketing, Yuki’s work—for the first time in her life—is actually fun! (Source: J-Novel Club) Note: Chapter count includes 8 volume prologues and 10 epilogues.

title: Adachi to Shimamura 99.9
description: As Adachi and Shimamura share life as adults, they’ve never been happier. Their relationship’s so close now, it may last into their golden years… maybe even for the next 3,700 years, in fact! Just how long can the pair stay the course together? Follow the galactic trajectory of their romance in this short story compilation. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Ao no Soujyu
title_original: 少女革命ウテナ -蒼の双樹-
description: Two light novels written by Ichiro Okouchi with illustrations by Chiho Saito, "Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Ao no Soujyu" and "Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Midori no Omoi" expand on material from the television series, with Ao no Soujyu focusing on the first five episodes of the series and Midori no Omoi focusing on Wakaba's Black Rose character arc.

title: Love Live! School idol diary: Kousaka Honoka
title_original: ラブライブ！ School idol diary ～高坂穂乃果～

title: Satou Kashi no Dangan wa Uchinukenai
title_original: 砂糖菓子の弾丸は撃ちぬけない
description: Nagisa Yamada is a junior high school student who lives in the remote countryside town of Tottori. Her father has passed away years ago, and her mother does part-time jobs to support the family. She is a realist, and wants to graduate as soon as possible to live her own life. Mokuzu Umino is a melancholic and very mysterious transfer student. She claims to be a mermaid, come to land on a mission to find a true friend before the storm comes. At Tottori, the two girls meet, develop a unique friendship, and do what they can to keep living.

title: Yuri Elf to Norowareta Hime
title_original: 百合エルフと呪われた姫
description: As long as we’re together, we’ll be happy. So begins a yuri adventure! Rem, an elven girl who had fled her home, arrived at a human town, where she met a cursed princess, Alferez. Sympathising with the other’s circumstances, the two women embark on a journey to break the curse! In their dangerous and obscene adventure, they learn more about the true nature of the curse, and about their own secrets…

title: Yuusha ni Naritai Boku to, Yuusha ni Narubeki Kimi
title_original: 勇者になりたい少女と、勇者になるべき彼女
title_en: The Girl Who Wants to Be a Hero and the Girl Who Ought to Be a Hero
description: After the Great Human-Demon War comes to a close, humans use a magical device known as the Gear to found the Hero Institute, a school for raising a new kind of hero. Ruchika, a wild and reckless demon girl, travels to the city in the hopes of joining the institute. There she meets Leonie, the serious- minded daughter of the Almighty Hero who defeated the Demon Lord. Taking a liking to her immediately, Ruchika proposes-right in the middle of their entrance exam! Do these two girls have what it takes to become heroes? And can love bloom between a human and a demon? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Yuri ni Hasamareteru Onna tte, Tsumi desu ka?
title_original: 百合に挟まれてる女って、罪ですか？

title: Zettai ni Derete wa Ikenai Tsundere
title_original: 絶対にデレてはいけないツンデレ
description: “Don’t get the wrong idea, okay. I definitely don’t like people such as you!” This template tsundere phrase marked the beginning of mine and Aotsuki Mifuyuu’s story. Because of her cold and indifferent attitude, she always stands out negatively in class. However one day, we ended up talking more and more with each other, and I started to see the warmth behind her cold words. Why is she so distanced and unaffectionate towards people despite being so kind? That seems to be related to her past that I don’t know about… This is a story about love, telling the coming along of a boy and girl until they finally act affectionately towards each other.

title: Furimukinasai, Watashi ni!
title_original: 振り向きなさい、わたくしに！
title_en: I'm In Love With the Villainess: Come on and Notice Me Already
description: Aleah, now 15 years old, advances to the girls' school created by Claire along with May, where she weaves the story together with Lilly and new characters.

title: Tonikaku Imouto ga Hoshii Saikyou no Kyuuketsu-hime wa Mujikaku Gohoushichuu
title_original: とにかく妹が欲しい最強の吸血姫は無自覚ご奉仕中!
title_en: Seriously Seeking Sister! Ultimate Vampire Princess Just Wants Little Sister; Plenty of Service Will Be Provided!
description: Long ago, on the continent of Ephenia, there existed the feared tribe of vampires called "True Bloods," whose great strength allowed them to reign supreme over all other tribes. However, a millennium has passed, and any trace of them has vanished off the face of the planet. That is, until the youngest and most talented royal daughter of the True Bloods awakens in the modern day. Vampire Princess Ristia has only one wish—a cute little sister! Monstrously strong, skilled in magic, and incredibly beautiful, people regard her as an "angel," but she assures everyone she's just a normal girl. Can this "normal girl" be the elder sister she so desires? Follow this (unusual) vampire through a fanservice-filled sibling-searching fantasy adventure. (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Shimekiri Mae ni wa Yuri ga Hakadoru
description: Ayu Shirakawa, who has run away from home. Through her cousin Miyako, Ayu is introduced to the author Yukari Ebiwara (penname Hikari Kairou), and starts a part time job as her caretaker. Yukari often slacks off by playing games and going on trips, but Ayu really enjoys her new everyday life. And as the two live together and grow closer, Ayu starts to have feelings she never had before.

title: Henjin no Salad Bowl
description: Sousuke Kaburaya, an impoverished detective, met Sara, a princess from another world with magical powers. Sara began living with Sousuke, and she quickly adjusted to life in modern Japan. Meanwhile, Livia, a female knight who came from the same world as Sara, found herself lost and homeless, but surprisingly enjoyed her days here. These two people, who live a positive life despite their situation, began to have an impact on Sousuke and the other oddballs in the neighborhood, including a devilish lawyer, a divorce agent, and a cult leader. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Adachi to Shimamura SS
description: From youth to maturity. From skipping school to sharing a bed. From classmates to lovers. This short story collection features dozens of fleeting scenes that illuminate the tumultuous relationship between Adachi and Shimamura, ordinary girls with an extraordinary connection.. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Savage Fang Ojou-sama Shijou Saikyou no Youhei wa Shijou Saikyou no Bougyaku Reijou to Natte Nidome no Sekai wo Musou Suru
title_original: サベージファングお嬢様 史上最強の傭兵は史上最凶の暴虐令嬢となって二度目の世界を無双する
description: The elegant warrior, Mylene, has a secret—inside her lurks the soul of the strongest mercenary in history, Savage Fang. This former sellsword will use her past experience and newfound powers to shape the world as she sees fit. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Shousetsu: Yoru no Kurage wa Oyogenai
title_original: 小説　夜のクラゲは泳げない

title: Kanojo no Kanojo to Fujun na Hatsukoi
title_original: 彼女のカノジョと不純な初恋
description: "In exchange for my help with your studies, you must stay let me stay at your house until summer vacation." If I get a failing mark again, my chance to live by myself will be over. So I'm forced to go along with the proposal from Tsukasa, the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. But then I saw them. I saw Tsukasa kissing a girl in the park. Tsukasa, who often annoys me with her abnormal invasions of my personal space, has a “girlfriend." Her yuri friend is against this arrangement because she thinks it's “cheating” even if it's between two girls, but Tsukasa is having none of it. After a while, my grades are improving and I'm beginning to enjoy living with Tsukasa. I know that “it's not cheating if you're not in love with them,” but… I'm okay with it. If I don't think about love, we can all get along and be happy, right? (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title: Douyara Watashi no Karada wa Kanzen Muteki no You desu ne
title_original: どうやら私の身体は完全無敵のようですね
description: On her deathbed, a sickly young girl wishes to be reborn with a strong body that will never succumb to anyone or anything. Lo and behold, her wish is granted! Upon reincarnating into another world as Mary Regalia, she discovers her new body has maxed-out attributes, from physical strength to defense—even magic. But wait! That isn’t what she really wanted! All she longed for was a normal life. Baffled by God’s choice to grant her wish in this most unexpected way, Mary tries to spend her days as uneventfully as possible. The hitch is...nothing’s harder than living a normal life when you’re absolutely invincible! (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Class no Hime wa Watashi no Wanko
title_original: クラスの姫は私のわんこ
description: I, Kurumi Nabana, and my classmate Seira Sorahashi aren't friends. In fact, we hardly ever talk in the classroom. I am a plain, ordinary girl, and she is widely considered to be the cutest girl in school, so our social circles do not intersect. Until one day, when Seira summoned me with a note to meet after school. "Kurumi,” she said, ”Would you like to be my master?" My daily life is dramatically changed because of this ridiculous “request." I tried to think of excuses, but I wouldn't want anyone else to hurt Sorahashi-san. So I said, “I'll do it....... I'll put it on." From today, I will be her master. Put a collar on her, train her, and take her for a walk behind closed doors. What in the world are we doing? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shouwaru Tensai Osananajimi to no Shoubu ni Makete Hatsu Taiken wo Zenbu Ubawareru Hanashi
title_original: 性悪天才幼馴染との勝負に負けて初体験を全部奪われる話
description: Yoshizawa Wakaba's childhood friend, Umezono Komaki, is perfect. She is a brilliant, well-behaved, honor student......, but beneath the surface, she is a vicious girl who looks down on others. I wanted to win over Komaki so badly that I tried to compete with her, even at the risk of losing "something important" - the result was my loss. And so Komaki said, "Wakaba, kiss me," and she stole away my first kiss. In order to regain my dignity, I challenge Komaki to another match, but she says that if she wins, she will take away another one of my most precious things.... Going on a date, sleeping in the same bed, even saying "I love you." I should have hated Komaki for taking all these first-times away from me, but what is this feeling that is filling my heart instead? (Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated) Note: Gold Prize winner in the 28th Sneaker Awards.

title: Yami Zokusei no Mahoutsukai daga, Naze ka Yuusha ni Natteshimatta: Sore wa Tomokaku Yome ni Ii Kurashi o Saseru Tame ni Ganbatte Nariagarou to Omou
title_original: 闇属性の魔法使いだが、なぜか勇者になってしまった ～それはともかく嫁にいい暮らしをさせるために頑張って成り上がろうと思う～
title_en: Busy Wizard: This Warlock Just Wants to Provide for his Wives!
description: After years of honing his magic deep in the mountains, eighteen-year-old Christophe dreams of making a name for himself in the imperial capital. But en route to the city where his fortune awaits, he meets a battered and beaten, yet surprisingly well-bred girl. (Source: Panty Press)

title: Gekitotsu no Hexennacht
title_original: OBSTACLEシリーズ 激突のヘクセンナハト
description: The earth is ruled by the Black Witch. The Black Witch was sealed in the moon and can only be judged once a decade on the night of Hexennacht. The ones who can fight the Black Witch are the chosen magical girls who have won their battles. Horinouchi Mitsuru, the Eastern Japan representative who aims to be the strongest, happens across a girl with strange power who says her name is Kagami Kagami. The girls "clash"! To save the world with their own power!!

title: Jussai no Saikyou Madoushi
description: A ten-year old girl named Ferris was a slave working in the magic stone mine. However, she was discovered to possess an astonishing amount of magical power, and she was enrolled in a magic academy. She is watched over by various people as her talent improved with tremendous speed. Every political faction made moves to try to control her power. Ferris was the only person who did not know she was a powerful magician. Ferris was satisfied as long as she had plenty to eat every day.

title: Miniskirt Uchuu Kaizoku
description: The story centers around a spirited high school girl named Marika. She keeps herself busy with the space yacht club and her part-time job at a high-class retro café. One day, two men suddenly appear and claim to be subordinates of her dead father. They demand that she assume command of the space pirate ship Benten Maru. A privateer ship's compact was made during a war of independence a century ago, and according to that compact, the ship must be inherited by the captain's next direct descendant. Marika finds herself embarking on a new life as a space pirate. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Yuusha Goroshi no Hanayome
description: In the light of day, Sister Alicia Snowell is a faithful and devoted bride of the gods, dedicated to serving the Holy Church and its followers. In the shadows, she’s one of the Church’s top inquisitors, tasked with hunting down and eliminating heretics by any means necessary. Alicia’s latest mission: assassinate the Hero Elcyon, slayer of the mighty Demon Lord, whose growing fame threatens to eclipse the Church’s political power. In order to kill the divinely protected, supposedly unkillable Hero, Alicia first needs to win Elcyon’s heart. There’s just one problem—Elcyon turns out to be a girl named Cion! Alicia’s at a loss for what to do, but while she tries to figure out how to seduce a girl, more trouble brews on the horizon. With remnants of the demon army still at large, Alicia and Cion face one deadly supernatural battle after another! Where will the two girls’ intertwining paths lead them? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Suki na Ko no Imouto
description: The one who fulfills my desires is the younger sister of the person I love―. A love triangle between the perfect older sister and her care-free younger sister. I, Yuka Amamiya, confessed my feelings to my first love, Nagisa Hanabusa... but I was rejected. Unable to let go of my lingering feelings, Nagisa's younger sister and my friend, Mino-chan, made a surprising offer. "I'll help you forget all about my sister." She offered to let me do everything I had wanted to do with Nagisa — but do it to her instead. I saw the shadow of the person I loved in her younger sister, and I started going on dates with Mino-chan, dressed as Nagisa, and... "Yuka-senpai, you're about to kiss a dear friend who's like a little sister, right?" I indulged in my desires, almost drowning in them. As I spent more time with Mino-chan, who was supposed to be a substitute for Nagisa, I found myself gradually falling for her― (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Oboreru Bed de, Tenshi no Negao wo Mitai dake. #Futari de Okashita Himitsu no Kousoku Ihan
title_original: 溺れるベッドで、天使の寝顔を見たいだけ。 #ふたりで犯した秘密の校則違反
title_en: Watching the Angel Sleep, Drowning in Bed Together
description: Ayana Yukihira is a second-year in high school, and after her parents’ divorce, she’s looking for a new start in an apartment of her own. But when she receives the keys, she finds another girl already there—fresh out of the bath! Due to an administrative error, the apartment was also rented out to Yuu Fukami, one of Ayana’s classmates at her new school. But instead of forcing Ayana to find another place to live, Yuu invites Ayana to share the lease as a roommate. As it turns out, the girls also share a mutual attraction that grows with every touch, every passing day…until they’re virtually drowning in it. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Carneades
description: This is a world inhabited by angels, demons, vampires, beastmen, and humans. Each of the five races has its own secrets and desires. No one yet knows the truth hidden within. But the opening bell is about to ring. (Source: MF Bunko, translated)

title: Shoujo Seikan Hyouryuuki
title_en: The Girls Adrift Among the Stars
description: AN INTERGALACTIC VOYAGE FOR A PLANET TO CALL HOME A horse-drawn carriage races across the cosmos. Or rather, a spaceship made to look like one. At the helm are a pair of refugees who fled Earth after pollution rendered it uninhabitable: Ridley, a scientist and the designer of this peculiar spacecraft, and Watari, an accomplished martial artist with debilitating shyness. This eccentric duo has but one goal—to find a stable planet where they can settle down on! However, every world the two visit is a little off… A planet with a god that can revive the dead, a planet where lucky people reign supreme, a planet lined with endless libraries… Can the girls navigate the unique challenges posed by each bizarre world and live to reach the next leg of their journey? And is there really a replacement for Earth waiting to be found among the stars? (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes a volume-bonus chapter.

title: Kirai Doushi no Watashitachi wa Ichiya no Ayamachi de
title_original: 嫌い同士のわたしたちは一夜の過ちで

title: Howling Blaze: Souen no Kenshi to Fushi no Majo
title_original: ハウリング・ブレイズ 葬焔の剣士と不死の魔女

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?) Tanpenshuu
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ!(※ムリじゃなかった!?) 短編集
title_en: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll Be Your Lover! Unless… Even More Stories to Love!
description: From Sena Ajisai's student council dreams to Satsuki's fangirling, see what else the crew is up to in this brand-new spinoff! While Amaori Renako panics over maintaining her image as a cool, popular girl who absolutely did not only recently stop shutting herself up in her room, the world keeps on turning. Sena Ajisai runs for the student council, Hitoe Hanatori joins the girls at the pool, and Satsuki writes a fan letter to her favorite author. It’s No Freaking Way, but this time, Renako’s sharing the spotlight! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shino to Ren: Future
description: Lovebirds Ren and Shino have left their school days behind and set out into the world of working adults. Independence is exciting, but living on their own and starting their careers come with a whirlwind of challenges. Ren is struggling to make time in her busy modeling schedule for her girlfriend. Shino is happy about Ren’s success, but she can’t help but notice all the admiring gazes Ren attracts. Then when they’re finally alone, Shino shies from physical intimacy! And to top it all off, Shino gets along with her coworkers and students so well that it’s stoking Ren’s jealousy. Do these high school sweethearts have what it takes to clear these hurdles and build a future together? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Deatte Hitotsuki de Zecchou Jorei!
title_original: 出会ってひと突きで絶頂除霊！
description: Climax Exorcism. It is the obscene ability that forces anyone, dead or alive, to climax when penetrated. And as a side effect, it also causes evil spirits and monsters to become purified and exorcised when they cum. Haruhisa Furuya, the boy who possesses this unholy ability, is one of the lowest-ranking students at the Exorcist Academy. After all, if he uses his ability, it would destroy his social standing (among other things)... But then Haruhisa meets someone, a girl named Misaki Souya, a girl with an evil eye capable of exposing people's secrets. (Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)

title: Senketsu Oujo, Mina Korosu
description: Mary is a princess who lacks the ability to use magic. Her arranged political marriage was set in stone, and she hoped to finally serve a purpose as a member of the royal family. However, during the engagement party, her engagement was abruptly broken off, and she was falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to execution. Betrayed by her own parents and brother, Mary manages to escape with her only ally, her older sister. Their attempt to flee is thwarted, and both Mary and her sister are killed by the most powerful mage known as the arcanist. But on the brink of death, Mary’s powers awaken. She possesses the arcana of the Death God, allowing her to devour corpses and augment her strength. With this newfound ability, Mary becomes determined to exact revenge on all those responsible for her sister’s death.

title: Himitsu: Kuro no Chikai
description: Rin, a young angel (presumed female, but angels don’t have clear genders) falls in love with a young human girl, Miku. However, their love is considered taboo, and so, Rin makes a deal with the devil to be reborn as the human boy, Len, in order to be with Miku. However, their happiness together is short-lived, and even that soon ends in tragedy.

title: Hataraku Watashi to Kanojo no Dousei
description: Mari is known as a "cold woman" who doesn't like to get involved with otherpeople. One day, Mari, who worked at a flower shop, was asked to take care of Sumirei, a high school girl who has lost her mother and has nowhere else to go due to her circumstances. Mari felt compelled to take her in. But Sumirei, who was still depressed with a broken heart, wasn't ready to talk, and they began to live together awkwardly. But over time, Mari got glimpses of Sumirei's family environment and school life. And as they spent time together, Sumirei gradually opened up to her. The more she learned about Sumirei's innocent lifestyle, the more Mari realized the weaknesses of her own emotional state. (Source: Fujimi L Bunko, translated)

title: Kenshi wo Mezashite Nyuugaku Shita noni Mahou Tekisei 9999 Nan desu kedo!?
title_original: 剣士を目指して入学したのに魔法適性9999なんですけど！？
description: Laura who had received special education to be a swordsman from her A-Rank adventurer father since a young age, enters the Royal Capital's Adventurer's school at the age of 9. Laura filled with expectation in her heart in hopes to make many swordsman friends. At the day of the entrance ceremony, Laura's sword aptitude value was measured at 107. Between normal students whose aptitude value is around 50-60, Laura was definitely a sword genius, but the magic aptitude that was measured after that was 9999. Laura was stunned, and while she didn't know what was even happening she was transferred to the Magic Department. Contrary to Laura's will, she exerts her super-genius, and instantly becomes stronger than anyone in the school.

title: Ashita no Sekai de Hoshi wa Kirameku
title_original: 明日の世界で星は煌めく
description: In a “ruined world” begins the adventures of two girls. A girl, who because of some special circumstances, was branded a “witch”, Yuki Minato. Even now that she’s in high school, her dark days are still not over. But on the second day of school, the world ended. The streets are now filled with lifeless beings, moving corpses, as humanity’s end approaches. A month later, Yuki managed to survive with a familiar and “magic” left by her missing father. One day, to replenish supplies, she went into the streets filled with moving corpses. On her way back, she heard a gunshot. Even though right now there’s no one in town that’s worth saving, in the past there was a kind girl she was close to. Remembering that girl, Minato decides to help the owner of the gun shot. When she arrives, in front of her was that girl, Honoka Sakaki. For Honoka’s goal, the two decided to work together, but… (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Yuri Kuma Arashi
description: Kureha Tsubaki is a shy second-year student at Arashigaoka Academy whose life takes a turn for the weird after she meets transfer student Ginko Yurishiro, who begins showing up in her dreams as a bear princess. Kureha becomes friends with Ginko only to discover that she is wrapped up in her own world and believes everything is made up of bears. When Kureha begins having feelings for Ginko, she decides to help her get to the bottom of her delusions. But are they really just delusions or something more…? (Source: Otakumode)

title: Kare nanka Yori, Watashi no Hou ga Ii Desho?
title_original: 彼なんかより、私のほうがいいでしょ？
description: That girl has a man she likes. I have to make it mine before I confess! "I think I have a favorite person ..." To that word, Kano Mizusawa's soul set out on a journey for a moment. Horimiya Oto is her childhood friend. She is attractive for her loose semi-long hair, has excellent grades except for exercise, is homely and attentive, and she has said that she has a man she likes. Even though we are girls, before I knew it, she was more than a close friend. Even so ... But even if the mind is impossible, if it is the body ...!" (!?) Thus, Kano's unreasonable and slightly radical [Sound capture strategy] begins! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kono Nukumori wo Kimi to Yobunda
title_original: このぬくもりを君と呼ぶんだ

title: Afternoon Tea wa Ikaga desu ka?: Watashi to Senpai no Fujun de Ichizu na Futarigurashi
title_original: アフタヌーンティーはいかがですか？ 私と先輩の、不純で一途なふたり暮らし

title: FLOWERS: Le volume sur printemps
title_original: FLOWERS ―Le volume sur printemps- フラワーズ〈春篇〉
description: Suoh: "Is it wrong if I fall in love with a girl?" Surrounded by immense walls in the middle of a forest, lies the prestigious all-girls school, Saint Angraecum Academy. It's a school that prides itself on growing bright and cultured young women. The school's Amitié program is designed to help foster new friendships that will last a lifetime. This is why Suoh Shirahane, a painfully shy girl with a mysterious past, has enrolled. As her first year of high school begins, she is filled with hopes of a new life. Follow her as she navigates her new friendships and attempts to unravel the many mysteries at the academy, including occult rituals and the mysterious disappearance of fellow students, all while trying to pass her classes. As spring warms into summer, so does Suoh's friendships until they too blossom into a love that is something more. More importantly, who will she choose?

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo, Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
title_original: 『人斬り』少女、公爵令嬢の護衛になる
description: Shurine is a girl who has mastered the sword, having been raised to serve as a bodyguard. However, she is falsely accused of assassinating the person she is guarding and forced to goes on the run. Driven from her home, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger after being caught up in a battle over royal succession. As Lutecia is being attacked by an assassin, Shurine makes her an offer, "I'm a bit short on money. If you need a bodyguard, I'm available right now." Their encounter will determine the fate of the kingdom! A girls-love swordplay battle fantasy begins! Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?) SS-shuu
title_original: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ！（※ムリじゃなかった!?） SS集
title_en: There’s No Freaking Way I’ll Be Your Lover! Unless… More Stories to Love!
description: After a traumatic middle school life where she spent most of her time in her room playing video games, Amaori Renako set out to become the ideal version of herself in high school. Now, she’s a member of a group of popular girls called the Quintet, dating the most beautiful girl in school, and living the high school dream! Now her daily life is so exciting that you could even fill a book with all the stuff she and her friends got up to in between the drama and romance! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Gokumon Nadeshiko Koko ni Ari
description: The Gokumon clan - a bloodline from hell. Living in their mysterious stronghold in the ancient capital of Kyoto, they command fear not only from those who wield magic, but also monsters and demons. Nadeshiko Gokumon is the monster-devouring heiress of this wicked family. She is the most beautiful, and the most abominable, girl who comes straight from the flames of hell. However...... "Nadeshiko, I see you are as lovely as your name." The encounter with the most strange, disturbing, and beautiful woman, Amana Ichijiku, who laughs in her face without fear, changes Nadeshiko. Something lurks in the flower ceiling. A human sacrifice packed in a box. A curse that threaten the school. A deceitful beast. A shapeless monster. As the two confront one supernatural challenge after another, they eventually come face to face with the very thing they have been turning away from. "If it weren't for you, I would still be an ogre." A woman with a human soul in an ogre's body and a girl with a monstrous soul in a human body. The connection between the two is a story that will be sealed with blood. (Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated) Note: Winner of the Grand Prize in the 17th Shogakukan Light Novel A

title: Sugu Kenka Suru Tokai Gyaru to Kyou-bijin wo Nakanaori Sasetai Dake na no ni! (※Watashi wo Toriau no wa Yamenasai!)
title_original: すぐケンカする都会ギャルと京美人を仲直りさせたいだけなのに! (※わたしを取り合うのはやめなさい!)
description: I'm sandwiched between a charismatic city gal and a pure and lovely Kyoto beauty... don't squish me! I, Kurimoto Tsubame, moved to Tokyo from the countryside and now, for some reason, I'm being pressed tightly between two beautiful girls. How did it end up like this...? I just want to make up the bitter rivalry between Seira-chan and Orine-san...! (Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title: Girls Kingdom
description: All Misaki wanted was a free education. Instead, she accidentally lands an exclusive contract with the most prestigious girl in school... to serve as her personal maid! Misaki soon discovers that Amanotsuka Academy for Girls is no ordinary school—her classes are all about how to be a maid, too! Students who impress the school’s elite young ladies with their domestic service skills might be lucky enough to become a “Seraph,” guaranteeing them a job with an upper-class household after they graduate. But Misaki doesn’t want to be a maid; she just wants to study hard, go to college, and work for a good company. So why did Himeko make her into her Seraph out of nowhere? What kind of rich girl hires a maid who wants nothing to do with the job?! If she wants to get through high school, Misaki has a lot to get used to! (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: TS Tensei Bishoujo Netora Reiko wa Netoraretai
title_original: TS転生美少女 音虎玲子は寝取られたい

title: Mikake wa Chou-seiso na Haraguro Joshi ni mo Asobareru Hanashi
title_original: 見かけは超清楚な腹黒女子にもてあそばれる話

title: Tensei Nanajo de Hajimeru Isekai Life
title_original: 転生七女ではじめる異世界ライフ
description: A high school girl, Kanami Miria, reincarnated as the seventh daughter of an aristocrat. Since she had lived a miserable life, she dreamed of living peacefully in her second life. However, she reincarnated in a super-poor aristocratic family in the countryside. In order to achieve her goal to leave the house and live a peaceful life, she practiced magic and secretly went to the Royal Girls Academy. But, thanks to her omnipotent magical power, her evaluation became ridiculous. The easygoing Miria decided to ignore all invitations and aim for a relaxing life with her omnipotent magical power.

title: Deretai Kanojo no Ura Omote
description: Shinonome Hyouka and Mashima Iori used to be childhood friends, but Hyouka's attitude changed drastically some time during junior high. The sweetheart Hyouka started treating Iori coldly whenever they met. However, when another childhood friend, Ameya Hikari, starts to make moves on Iori, Hyouka's attitude towards Iori also begins to waver... (Source: GC Novels, translated)

title: Osananajimi wa, Nyaa to Naite Skirt no Naka
title_original: 幼馴染は、にゃあと鳴いてスカートのなか
description: When I saw “Maki Saihara” listed in the roster of my new class, the weight of that name made me feel as if I can't move at all. Maki is a dear childhood friend, but we haven't spoken in over a year. (How did I talk to Maki......?) The distance between me and my childhood friend seems very far, even though she is sitting right next to me in the same classroom. Until one day, when Maki suddenly comes over to my house. "Ichika, I want to show you something." Something suddenly pops out of her head. Cat ears! In no time at all, the distance that had separated us disappears. Now Maki, whose personality has become like that of a cat as well, comes and lies down next to me, rubs herself against me, and spoils me with just the two of us in this carefree time. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nekonoyama Neneko wa Nekoninaru
title_original: 猫ノ山寧々子はネコになる
description: Nekonoyama Neneko is a demi-human high school girl who can turn into a cat. Trying to hide her true identity from the world, she is shy around other people except for her family. The only outsider she trusts is her older sister’s friend, Mashiro. Neneko can't help but be drawn to the cool and mysterious Mashiro. One day, Neneko discovers that Mashiro is a vampire, and she proposes living together as her blood donor (partner). This is a romance between girls clumsy at love. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Death Loop Reijou wa Ikinokoru Tame ni Ryoute wo Chi ni Someru You desu
title_original: デスループ令嬢は生き残る為に両手を血に染めるようです
description: "Until the demon lurking among the participants is slain, this game shall not end." Lady Hermina, the daughter of the Count Einhorn, finds herself entangled in a deadly game called the "Summoning Ritual of a Wicked God" within an ancient northern castle, alongside her childhood friend and maid, Charlotte. Among the eight participants at the castle, two are designated as "demons," tasked with murdering one person each night. Those who are not demons must execute a suspicious individual through daily voting, participants are unable to leave the castle until all demons are annihilated. In this game where death looms, Hermina must use all of her wits to survive, while trying to protect Charlotte, but...!? (Source: Lanove, translated)

title: 17-sai to, 18-ijou: Kouhai Gyaru wa Watashi to xx wo Shiritairashii
title_original: 17歳と、18以上 ～後輩ギャルは私と××を知りたいらしい～

title: Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban
description: "Witches lurk among these girls." It was supposed to be Ema's first day of high school. But instead of waking up in her bed, she found herself in a dark prison cell. She found herself suddenly trapped in an island prison, isolated in some unknown, distant sea. In her confusion, an owl informed Ema of her new situation: "You have been identified as a potential witch — a threat to the world. Thus, you will live here as a prisoner for the rest of your life." The life Ema had taken for granted had suddenly collapsed. As she began her new life as a prisoner, Ema got to know the other girls in her situation. Her fellow witch candidates. However, one day, the owl gathered the prisoners for a shocking announcement: "We will be holding a witch trial." One by one, the girls would have to single out a witch among the thirteen of them... In other words, they would have to vote out the next candidate to be executed. It was the beginning of a cruel game indeed... (Source: Steam)

title: Yuutousei ga Adult Goods wo Kai ni Kita
title_original: 優等生がアダルトグッズを買いに来た
description: Aya Mizuki, a high school girl working part-time at a used bookstore that also sells adult goods, runs into Yuuki Kayano, a top student from her class, at work one day. Yuuki, who is highly respected at school, was actually carefully looking for items for items for “stress relief.” “Please just keep this a secret from the school and my parents…” Their relationship based on a shared little secret began with this unexpected encounter. Yuuki gradually finds herself drawn to Aya, who is cool yet kindhearted and listens to her worries without judging her. Even when she’s “doing it” alone, she can’t help but think of Aya. Just then, a rumor starts spreading that Aya and Yuuki are dating…? (Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Shoujo no Nozomanu Eiyuu-tan
description: "Which is the real you!?" Likes: Cooking, eating, and being pampered. Specialty: Murder. Krische Alberinea Christand, a general of the Alberan Kingdom, is the greatest genius in both military and magical history. She is the prodigy who single-handedly brought an end to the era of swords and heroes through numerous magical revolutions. Though widely feared as a cold-blooded and unparalleled slaughterer, the reality of her character is quite different. She is actually a slightly gluttonous, affectionately spoiled girl who cheerfully asks, "Ehehe, what's for dinner today?" This somewhat airheaded and eccentric girl has but one simple wish: to spend peaceful days with the people she holds dear. Nothing more. However, as if to mock those desires, a cruel fate forces a sword into the hands of a 12-year-old village girl, dragging her onto a battlefield ruled by death and violence. An unprecedented, common-sense-defying ultimate heroine makes her appearance! She offers an angel's smile to those she loves, and a single, fatal flash of the blade to those who oppose her. Follow the kingdom's strongest god of war as she traces the guideposts to happiness in this "girls' memento mori."

title: Kao dake Ii Classmate ga, Yatara to Guigui Kuru Yuri no Hanashi.
title_original: 顔だけ良いクラスメイトが、やたらとグイグイ来る百合の話。

title: Enman Katei no Hitozuma ga Musume no Tomodachi ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
title_original: 円満家庭の人妻が娘の友達にドはまりする話
description: Yuki Amamiya is a highly regarded designer with a stable life. She has a good relationship with her husband and daughter, and they have a dog together. It’s a harmonious, picture-perfect family. She never harbored a single doubt about her family and believed this life would smoothly go on forever. …Until that day, when she met Kai. She was her daughter’s classmate — childlike in appearance, yet with words, actions, and a gaze that challenged even adults. But Yuki couldn’t ignore the occasional flashes of insecurity that were so typical for her age… “I don’t mind you touching me, Yuki, but you're getting me all excited.” “…You perverted brat.” This is the story of a happily married woman who ends up doing XX with her daughter’s friend. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shirayuri-san Kaku Katariki.
title_original: 白百合さんかく語りき。

title: Yuri Love Slave: Watashi Dake no Iinchou
title_original: 百合ラブスレイブ わたしだけの委員長

title: Mob Shoujo ga Last Boss Majo wo Shiawase ni Suru made
title_original: モブ少女がラスボス魔女を幸せにするまで
description: "I want to see your smile again" — A new girls' fantasy! A girl remembers. That this is a game world. That she had been reincarnated as a mob character. That her best friend would one day become a witch who freezes the world. And — that she would become the final boss and be destroyed. "I promise, I won't let Grace become a bad person." She refuses to accept such an ending! The girl Roselika makes her resolve and takes the hand of her best friend Grace, who has manifested the supernatural power that will turn her into a witch. She pulls her away from the family that drove her to the edge, and uses every bit of knowledge she has to defy fate. Gradually, Grace's frozen heart begins to thaw — "No matter what happens, I won't have any regrets. Because I love you, Roselika." — Being told that so directly... my heart can't help but race. (Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title: Houkago no Kyoushitsu ni, Koi wa Tsumoru.
title_original: 放課後の教室に、恋はつもる。
description: "Sensei, you're the one who made me feel this way." Today, Meisa Uehara, the most popular girl in class, once again confesses love to her introverted and plain-looking Japanese teacher. "As your teacher, I can't respond to your feelings." "Only because you're my teacher, not as a woman? Well, maybe when I graduate then." "Alright, sensei. Let's go on a date some time. I'll pick out a cute outfit for you." "Uehara-san, have you listened to anything I said?" Despite her protests, they spend Christmas together, sleeping in the same bed, accept a kiss on the wrist, and starts feeling anxious when Uehara doesn't call. She doesn't want to admit it. but she has fallen hopelessly in love with her student, who is seven years younger. It would be a relationship that crosses the line. A student x teacher age-gap girls' love story. (Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title: Saikyou no Youhei Shoujo no Gakuen Seikatsu: Shoujo to Shoujo, Kaikousuru
title_original: 最強の傭兵少女の学園生活 ―少女と少女、邂逅する―

title: Maid ni Chikaramake Suru Nante Hazukashikunain desu ka?
title_original: メイドに力負けするなんて恥ずかしくないんですか?
description: Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title: Dageki-kei Onikko ga Iku Haishindou!
title_original: 打撃系鬼っ娘が征く配信道！
description: Futayado Nanako calls herself a part time warrior, though all the places she worked at got bankrupt, now has too much time on her hands. And to that opportunity, she was invited by a very close friend of hers, a pro gamer and a live streamer, and decided to do the world’s first VRMMO with a live stream function 《WorldLive-ONLINE》. And so, a real cheat girl who has extraordinary strength (21 years old) carries a blunt weapon and rampages through the VR world, a bludgeoning refreshing story where the viewers tremble in fear!

title: Vampire Hunter ni Yasashii Gal
title_original: ヴァンパイアハンターに優しいギャル
title_en: This Gyaru’s Got a Thing for...Vampire Hunters?!
description: Deadly monsters who stalked innocents in the night and preyed upon them in secret, versus the select few who used mysterious powers honed by intense training and determination to battle their foes... This was the world of bloodshed that Ginka Shijunana knew and lived for—an endless clash between vampires and vampire hunters—until one final victory ended their war. Ginka decides to become a normal high school student now that her vampire hunting days are over, but her combat skills are no match for the challenges of everyday interactions with other teenagers. Still, she hits it off with the flashy and fashionable gyaru Ruka Moriki. When remnants of Ginka’s old life start to mysteriously reappear, however, will she pull Ruka into the darkness with her? Or will Ruka help her remain in the light? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Seijo Sensei no Mahou wa Susunderu!
title_original: 聖女先生の魔法は進んでる！
description: Despite being the most powerful saint, Tia was accused of being a heretic and banished from the royal capital. She became the teacher for three girls who had failed as candidate saints. "Sensei, if you fly into the capital on a dragon, will you get into trouble!" "This is all sensei's fault!! What the hell was that?" "I want to be the strongest too. Please teach me, sensei?" The "combination" of their talents and Tia's saintly magic will lead to extraordinary results, ranging from the ultra-fast cultivation of crops to raising dragons to one-on-one combat. I will guide you with all my knowledge. The girls who adore their saintly teacher grow up to become the strongest saints themselves, surprising even their own country! (Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title: Yuusha no Tabi no Uragawa de
title_en: Unsung Epics of the Hero's Journey
description: A hero has been chosen by the divine blade! She's due to set out on a journey to defeat the archfiend, leaving the city abuzz. But from the shadows dawns a prophecy that the hero will be cut down before she ever reaches the archfiend's stronghold. To avert this tragedy, the temple dispatches Rhuys Ferme to redirect the stream of events leading to the hero's death and to keep the omen secret. Only problem is that this is a job for two. Enter Araignée: (in)famously skilled adventurer who's willing to help—for a price. And no one said it'd just be money that Rhuys had to pay. (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Shiroi Dress to Akai Tsuki ga Tokeau Yoru ni
title_original: 白いドレスと紅い月がとけあう夜に
description: In a world where humans and supernatural beings have begun to coexist, the Special Operations Squad deals with ongoing incidents between the two races. One night, Rin, a sword-wielding squad member, rushes to a crime scene only to find—a blood-soaked vampire princess, Lavia, standing beside a headless corpse of a fellow squad member. Though evidence at the scene suggests Lavia couldn’t have done it, she remains the sole suspect as a high-ranking vampire. To convince her commander who insists on detaining Lavia, Rin forms a contract with her: “A pledge to drink no human blood except Rin’s”! With nowhere else to go, Lavia is invited to Rin’s home, beginning their cohabitation in search of the true culprit. As they unravel the mystery behind the incident, their daily life of shared blood and emotions gradually deepens into a bond that transcends species… (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Akogare no Onee-sama ga 'Imouto ni Naritai' tte Amaete Kurundakedo!?
title_original: 憧れのお姉様が「妹になりたい」って甘えてくるんだけど!?

title: Ebiten: Kitan Kitan
title_original: えびてん 綺譚奇譚

title: Ningyoutsukai
description: The beautiful young girl Kagura is a talented puppet master who also hunts down monsters at night. Out of a random encounter, she meets a vampire girl named Suzune. As Kagura was born in a complicated family, she was even discriminated by others monster slaying gang members. In order to protect herself, she was forced to provoke more enemies. During one of the attacks, Suzune decided to save her and soon they befriended each other. After several struggles Kagura is determined to leave everything behind. Together with Suzune, the two began their journey of seeking each other's happiness. (Source: Back cover of the novel, translated)

title: Ningen-chan no Keikaishin ga Ususugiru!
title_original: 人間ちゃんの警戒心が薄すぎる!

title: Do-Type Onee-san no Yuuwaku ga Tomaranai! Chicchai Koro kara Watashinokoto ga Daisukina Toshishita Juumai no Oyome-san ni Natchaimashita! ?
title_original: どタイプお姉さんの誘惑が止まらないっ！ ちっちゃい頃から私のことがだいすきな年下従妹のお嫁さんになっちゃいました!?
description: Until death do us part... let's stay together forever, big sis! Otose Koito is a high school girl who fell into a coma after an accident while protecting her young cousin. When she wakes up, she finds herself in a world 10 years in the future!? Her cousin has grown into the adult woman she likes and is increasingly coming on to her - her sanity is at its limit with these exciting days!?

title: Futsu Ota Hairimasen!: Gakeppuchi Seiyuu, Radio de Jinsei Restart!
title_original: ふつおたはいりません！ ～崖っぷち声優、ラジオで人生リスタート！～
description: Kanae Yoshioka, 27, voice actor. After playing the lead role in a popular series once, she has continued to play supporting roles, but then she gets a job on a radio show. Kanae is excited, thinking it's her chance to survive, but her partner, popular voice actress Kiri, who is 10 years younger than her, is strangely cold towards her... Can Kanae turn their relationship into an interesting radio show?!

title: "E, Watashi ga Socchi na no!?" Koinu-kei Kouhai Kanojo ni Taberareru Kakkoii Watashi
title_original: 「え、私がそっちなの！？」子犬系後輩彼女に食べられるカッコいい私

title: Dare ga Watashi no Yuri nano ka!?
title_original: だれがわたしの百合なのか!?
description: The sender is in the student council room! It all started with an anonymous love letter in a drawer in the student council room. "Dear Namiki Hitoha, I love you". Only three student council members were able to freely enter and leave the room. The talented Saibara Miyako, candidate for student council president; the socially active gal Kouchi Kanoa, who is friends with the entire student body; and the divine artist Yoshino Sakihi, who has many fans in the school. There must be someone among them who likes me...! In order to find the sender of the letter, Lily, I, an ordinary girl, decide to go on a date with each of the three. However, even though there is only one sender, for some reason they all seem suspicious...!?

title: Atarashiku Dekita Onee-san wa, Yuri to Iu no ga Suki Mitai
title_original: 新しくできたお姉さんは、百合というのが好きみたい
description: When their parents suddenly remarried, Haruka and Saori suddenly became sisters. Haruka had already quit her job and was living with her parents, so she thought that Saori, who was cool and focused on her work, lived in a different world... but then she was suggested to live together! The distance between the two of them grows closer as Haruka helps out her "older sister" Saori with the housework, which she is not good at. Saori, who longs for family ties, also enjoys getting to know her "younger sister". But Saori has a secret. She is a "real yuri" and has fallen in love with the easygoing Haruka at first sight. If she'll found out, Saori might lose the family bond she has worked so hard to obtain, and Haruka... She can't say it. But she wants to get closer! A certain incident takes a sudden turn in the days of these two step-sisters!? The girls' love comedy about these two step-sisters begins!

title: Joshikosei Doshi ga Mata Koi ni Ochiru Kamo Shirenai Hanashi.
title_original: 女子高生同士がまた恋に落ちるかもしれない話。
description: I met my first love, a girl, again. A story of two girls revisiting their first love. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Watashi no Kaidanshi wa Ponkotsu Kawaii
title_original: 私の怪談師はポンコツ可愛い
